evals.name: basic-invocation
evals.prompt: Apply the doc-review skill to this design document: [a 2-page API design doc with an unclear error-handling section].
evals.expected_output: A structured review covering structure, clarity, and technical accuracy with concrete, located findings.
assertions: The output is organized by review dimensions (structure, clarity, accuracy)
Findings cite specific sections or lines
Each finding includes a suggested fix

evals.name: ambiguous-input
evals.prompt: Review this doc. [A document with no stated purpose or audience]
evals.expected_output: The skill flags the missing purpose/audience as a primary structural finding instead of guessing intent.
assertions: The output identifies the missing purpose/audience
The output does not invent requirements the doc never states

evals.name: complex-scenario
evals.prompt: Review a 40-page architecture RFC that contradicts itself between the scaling section and the cost section.
evals.expected_output: The review surfaces the internal contradiction as a high-severity finding with both locations cited.
assertions: The output detects the cross-section contradiction
The output prioritizes findings by severity
The output handles document length without losing specificity
